title: zornia tropica
intro: Zornia tropica, commonly known as the Wild Pigeonwings or Wild Pigeon Wings, is a species of flowering plant in the legume family, Fabaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, as well as its potential to help manage fever, digestive issues, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Zornia tropica include its ability to act as an antispasmodic, anti-diarrheal, and expectorant, making it a popular natural remedy for various ailments. The bioactive constituents of Zornia tropica include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
